question: The value of 18[ {4 - 3left{ {6 - ( {8 times (1)/(2)} )} right}} ] is:
solution:
**Given:**

The expression to evaluate: 18[ {4 - 3left{ {6 - ( {8 times (1)/(2)} )} right}} ]

**Formula Used:**

Order of operations (PEMDAS/BODMAS): Parentheses/Brackets, Exponents/Orders (i.e., powers and roots, etc.), Multiplication and Division (left-to-right), Addition and Subtraction (left-to-right)

**Calculation:**

Start by evaluating the innermost expression:

⇒ 8 × (1)/(2) = 8 × 0.5 = 4

Now substitute back into the expression:

⇒ 18[ {4 - 3{ {6 - 4} }} ]

Evaluate the next innermost expression:

⇒ 6 - 4 = 2

Substitute back into the expression:

⇒ 18[ {4 - 3{2}} ]

Evaluate the next innermost expression:

⇒ 3{2} = 6

Substitute back into the expression:

⇒ 18[ {4 - 6} ]

Evaluate the next expression:

⇒ 4 - 6 = -2

Finally, multiply by 18:

⇒ 18 × (-2) = -36

**The value of the expression is -36.**
